newsitem.title: USA: Vermont Yankee sees nuke at full power by weekend.
newsitem.headline: Vermont Yankee sees nuke at full power by weekend.

text.p: Vermont Yankee Nuclear Power Corp said Thursday its 510 megawatt (MW) Vermont Yankee plant would achieve full output this weekend after restarting from a refueling outage.

The Vernon, Vt., station's reactor was operating at less than one percent of capacity early today, a company spokesman said, adding the plant would send power to the transmission system "either tonight or Friday morning."
"It usually takes about a day," he said when asked how long it will take for the plant to reach full power after it synchronizes to the grid.

Vermont Yankee is owned by a consortium of New England utilities including Central Vermont Public Service Co (31.3 percent), New England Electric System (20), Green Mountain Power (17.9), Northeast Utilities (16) and Central Maine Power Co (4.0).
